title: Trump’s threat to strike Iran raises public concerns, congressional questions
summary: WASHINGTON: President Donald Trump has renewed his threat of military action against Iran, raising questions about public support for the war and Congress’s ability to restrain further escalation . Reports of renewed US-Israeli military planning have also raised concerns about possible strikes after the elections.
